model_annotation: This donut chart visually represents two categorical distributions related to ambiguity metrics: the outer ring shows the distribution of standard deviation values (Ambiguity Std) with four segments—dark blue (Std: 0.0, 49.0%), medium-dark blue (Std: 0.47, 47.7%), medium-light blue (Std: 0.82, 7.0%), and light blue (Std: 0.94, 5.0%)—while the inner ring displays the distribution of maximum ambiguity levels (Max Ambiguity) with three segments—lightest blue (Max: 1, 38.0%), medium-light blue (Max: 2, 39.0%), and medium-dark blue (Max: 3, 14.2%). The chart includes two separate legends on the right side, one for the outer ring and one for the inner ring, correlating each color with its respective category. Percentage values are clearly labeled within each segment of both rings. The outer ring segments are arranged in descending order of percentage, while the inner ring segments appear to be ordered by increasing maximum value. The chart does not show any exploded or emphasized segments.
